title: Block Encoding Non-Abelian Lattice Gauge Theory
summary: Gauge theories like lattice QCD present a complex problem for quantum simulation. In a basis where the electric part of the Hamiltonian is simple, the magnetic part, generally expressed as a sum over the plaquette operators of the lattice, is quite complicated, producing correlated transitions between several link and site degrees of freedom. We provide an efficient block encoding of the plaquette operator in the irrep basis, a refinement of the electric basis where the internal gauge-variant degrees of freedom are integrated out.
